key_point: The player who got a real sword
title: The player who got a real sword
caption: Bandai Namco sent Elden Ring hero Let Me Solo Her a real sword after his 1,000th Malenia kill. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #eldenring #letmesoloher

instagram.caption:
Malenia stopped thousands of Elden Ring players cold. Then a hero appeared: a player in a pot helmet and underwear called Let Me Solo Her.

He jumped into strangers' games and beat Malenia alone for them, more than a thousand times.

Bandai Namco sent him a real engraved sword, a Malenia wood carving and a cloak. The internet's hero became official.

Did Let Me Solo Her ever save you?
